label: Project config is .vibe/config.toml, found by walking up parents to a trusted file; an untrusted project config is ignored unless --trust is passed.
Project discovery is non-recursive and covers .vibe/tools, .vibe/skills, .vibe/plugins, .vibe/agents, .vibe/prompts, .vibe/config.toml and .agents/skills; there is no .vibe/commands.
Config layers are user-toml, user-supplied, project-toml, environment (VIBE_*) and overrides, plus an agent-profile layer barred from overriding the three credential-routing base URLs.
AGENTS.md is two-level: $VIBE_HOME/AGENTS.md as the user doc, project AGENTS.md collected walking up to the project root outermost-first, and subdirectory AGENTS.md injected lazily on file reads.
Custom agents are TOML profiles in ~/.vibe/agents or discovered .vibe/agents, extended by agent_paths; default_agent defaults to accept-edits in both interactive and programmatic mode.
Skills load from skill_paths plus .vibe/skills and .agents/skills with enabled/disabled glob or re: patterns, and the experimental registry mode lets project skills win name collisions.
$VIBE_HOME is a fixed global tree (config.toml, AGENTS.md, .env, logs, worktrees, trusted_folders.toml, caches, history), so a repo mirror must live in .vibe/ rather than depend on home state.
A .vibe/ mirror would hold config.toml, agents/*.toml, skills/, plugins/, prompts/ and tools/; OpenCode command markdown has no .vibe/commands counterpart and must become prompts or skills.
